text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san, that teacup that arrived in my 
room―― Is that...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Here's a birthday present from 
Curren☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Believe-san often runs alongside me, 
and the other day she even gave me some 
advice about away races...――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
From Curren's perspective, there's a very 
good reason☆ I picked out an ultra-cute 
one, so please make sure to use it a lot, 
okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The way that glaze flows... That is the 
work of a true master artisan.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That calculation doesn't add up for my 
job.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren made sure to pick out a gift that 
perfectly matches how happy you made her, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Whatever falls short, I will repay with my 
work.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's no way it's not enough, though... 
You never change, do you♪ Believe-san.
